description: A provider-reported relationship between routes and group routes. Identity is `externalId` within the reporting plugin and auth link; resubmitting the same `externalId` updates the relationship. Omission from a later synchronization is not a deletion instruction.

externalId.description: Plugin-owned stable identifier of the relationship.

interfaces.description: Optional interface applicability; used by `CAN_CONTROL` to declare which messages the source supports on the target.
